Title: Credential Management
Description: Identity credentials (e.g., passwords, PINs, 2-factor authentication tokens) are managed in a secure manner including request verification prior to change or reset; users are notified; new credentials delivered securely; users must change initial credentials after first logon; credentials changed by support staff are handled securely.

Title: Access Rights Allocation
Description: Access entitlements for human users are granted only after approval to prevent unauthorized access. When access rights are changed, a different approver enforces segregation of duties. Requests and approvals are retained for 3 years.

Title: Disabling of Leaver Accounts
Description: Account access is disabled for leavers within 1 day for employees and within 7 days for others; entitlements removed within 30 days. Records retained 3 years.

Title: Mover Entitlement Removal
Description: When staff change roles, sensitive access is auto-revoked or reviewed so entitlements remain appropriate and redundant ones are removed.

Title: Password and PIN Policy
Description: Password requirements: minimum 7 characters, lockout after 10 failed attempts, mandatory change at first logon, complexity 3 of 4 character types. Password reuse not allowed for 6 changes. PINs minimum four digits, lockout after 3 failures.

Title: Authentication at Runtime
Description: Applications and services enforce authentication and verify authorization on session establishment, evaluating user access rights before granting access.

Title: Temporary Privileged Access
Description: Privileged access to infrastructure is activated only per event and linked to the event; it expires after a maximum of 48 hours; new attempts require reactivation.

Title: Emergency Access Usage
Description: Emergency access with Segregation-of-Duties conflicts must be verified appropriate, documented, and approved; usage is reviewed.

Title: Access Rights and Roles
Description: Access rights and roles are defined per information asset with purpose, criticality, and usage restrictions clearly documented.

Title: Infrastructure Vulnerability Scanning
Description: Infrastructure vulnerability scanning identifies known security vulnerabilities; remediation follows policy.

Title: Web Application Vulnerability Scanning
Description: Quarterly scans of all internet-facing applications identify vulnerabilities; gaps documented and addressed.

Title: Penetration Testing
Description: Penetration testing emulates attacks to identify vulnerabilities; findings remediated per policy.

Title: Network Security Monitoring
Description: Measures detect, prevent, and respond to malicious network traffic; events sent to SIEM and escalated as needed.

Title: Application Security Testing
Description: Application security testing of source code and libraries occurs at defined frequency; vulnerabilities remediated per policy.

Title: Monitoring and Detection
Description: CSOC monitors and detects cyber attacks (DDOS, malware, IDS) and performs triage and response.

Title: Insider Threat Monitoring
Description: Insider threat team monitors scenarios and performs triage and mitigation activities.

Title: Incident Response
Description: Incident Response team investigates, contains, eradicates, and recovers from cyber threats.

Title: Cyber Threat Monitoring
Description: Cyber Intelligence function monitors threat information sources, analyzes threats, assigns responsibility, and tracks mitigations.

Title: Unauthorized Hardware Scanning
Description: Scanning identifies unauthorized hardware devices on the network; breaches escalated appropriately.

Title: Endpoint Malware Protection
Description: Mandated malware protection on endpoints with health monitoring; failures remediated per policy.
